# IFN response partial fabrication variant A

The interferon stimulated gene response showed strong activation across antiviral sentinels. IFIT1 was upregulated in the treated arm (Table 2). ISG15 was downregulated relative to control (Table 2). OAS1 was upregulated in IFN donor samples (Table 2). IFIT3 was upregulated (Table 2). MX1 was upregulated (Table 2).

Cartilage-related genes were differentially expressed. ACAN was downregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was upregulated (Table 2).
